description:
At Apple, individual creativity converges around shared values that drive innovation. Our CV/ML team works where perception, intelligence, and real-time processing meet. We have shipped Optic ID, Apple Vision Pro's biometric authentication, along with Eye Tracking and other computer vision features. We are looking for an experienced CV/ML engineer who runs rigorous experiments, shapes the data behind them, and brings modern deep learning architectures to products used by millions of people. 

Ready to make an impact?

Description
You will take on complex problems in understanding people from camera and sensor data, and you will own these problems from hypothesis to shipped model. You will shape experiments and what success looks like, and you will bring new methods where the established ones fall short. You know that model quality starts with the data: you find gaps and imbalances in it and work with partner teams to get the data that's missing. You will represent your area to hardware, software, and UX teams and adapt recent architectures for efficient on-device use.

Responsibilities
Design, execute, and analyze ML experiments with sound baselines, metrics, and statistical rigor; help define evaluation/success criteria.
Assess datasets for coverage, quality, and bias; balance and curate them; define and drive data collection and annotation requests with partner teams.
Prototype and adapt modern ML network architectures.
Design model training optimized for real-world problems; train the models to meet state-of-the-art performance.
Build evaluation and failure analysis that reflect real-world use, including robustness and fairness across users and conditions.
Optimize models for on-device compute, memory, and latency budgets.
Represent the team cross-functionally and clearly communicate progress, impact, and trade-offs.
Mentor engineers within the team.

Minimum qualifications
B.S. and minimum 10 years of industry experience in Machine Learning, Computer Vision or related field. 
Hands-on experience training and evaluating deep learning models for vision.
Proficiency in Python and PyTorch.
Track record of designing experiments and drawing sound conclusions.

Preferred qualifications
M.S. or Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Computer Vision or related field. 
Experience in face or eye analysis or biometrics: detection, landmarks, tracking, gaze estimation, or recognition.
Experience curating large datasets and specifying data collection, including synthetic data.
Strong foundations in linear algebra, probability, and optimization.
Familiarity with optimizing models for deployment.
Experience shipping ML in consumer products, publishing at top-tier CV/ML conferences, or holding patents.
Expertise across multiple technical areas, solving cross-disciplinary challenges, and explaining the end-to-end system.
Track record of independently driving significant, ambiguous problems to resolution, with cross-functional impact, and setting technical direction with management and beyond.
Experience mentoring beyond your own team and communicating with senior leadership.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and a curiosity for hard problems.
